description: This file defines the ShuffleManager trait and its companion object in Apache Spark, providing interfaces and utilities for managing shuffle operations, including registering shuffles, obtaining readers and writers, and creating ShuffleManager instances based on configuration.

classes.name: ShuffleManager
classes.description: Pluggable interface for shuffle systems, managing shuffle registration, data reading/writing, and lifecycle.

methods.name: registerShuffle
methods.description: Registers a shuffle with the manager and returns a handle.

methods.name: getWriter
methods.description: Provides a writer for a specific shuffle partition.

methods.name: getReader
methods.description: Provides a reader for a range of reduce partitions.

methods.name: unregisterShuffle
methods.description: Removes shuffle metadata from the manager.

methods.name: shuffleBlockResolver
methods.description: Returns the resolver capable of retrieving shuffle block data.
